```{r}
pipelines <- read.csv("data/pipelines.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
groups <- read.csv("data/strategy_groups.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
lookup <- setNames(groups$group_name, groups$group_id)
pipelines$strategy_group <- unname(lookup[pipelines$workflow_group])
linkify <- function(url, label) {
  if (!nzchar(url)) return(htmltools::htmlEscape(label))
  paste0(
    '<a href="', htmltools::htmlEscape(url, attribute = TRUE),
    '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(label), '</a>'
  )
}
pipelines$source <- vapply(pipelines$source_url, linkify, character(1), label = "Repository")
pipelines$citation_link <- mapply(linkify, pipelines$citation_url, pipelines$citation, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
```


```{r}
catalog <- pipelines[, c(
  "name", "year", "license", "developers", "status", "strategy_group",
  "intended_taxa", "capable_taxa_summary", "identification_strategy", "report_summary",
  "source", "citation_link", "notes"
)]
names(catalog) <- c(
  "Pipeline", "Year", "License", "Developing group", "Status", "Strategy",
  "Intended taxa", "Capable taxa", "Core tools & identification approach", "HTML/PDF report",
  "Source code", "Citation", "Notes"
)
DT::datatable(
  catalog,
  elementId = "pipeline-catalogue",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  escape = c(1:10, 13),
  class = "compact stripe pipeline-table",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 100,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
    scrollX = FALSE,
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    dom = '<"pipeline-table-search"f>rt<"pipeline-table-footer"lip>',
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "8%", targets = 0),
      list(width = "4%", targets = 1),
      list(width = "5%", targets = 2),
      list(width = "8%", targets = 3),
      list(width = "8%", targets = 4),
      list(width = "8%", targets = 5),
      list(width = "8%", targets = 6),
      list(width = "8%", targets = 7),
      list(width = "14%", targets = 8),
      list(width = "8%", targets = 9),
      list(width = "5%", targets = 10),
      list(width = "6%", targets = 11),
      list(width = "10%", targets = 12)
    )
  )
)
```

Each citation links to its primary reference; repository links open the source code. Scope and screening boundaries are summarized on the [Overview](index.qmd#inclusion-criteria) page.
